subject: mathematics
concept: Finding unknown angles in a triangle (angles sum to 180 degrees)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tears the corners off a virtual paper triangle and arranges them along a straight line to see they total 180 degrees
exercise.pictorial: Student labels the missing angle on a pictured triangle diagram
exercise.abstract: Student calculates an unknown angle in a triangle given the other two angles

misconception_flags: uses 360 instead of 180 as the angle sum for a triangle

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
